findings.detail: FX01 appears to treat rows with omitted repeated dollar symbols as non-USD even though the SOI columns are dollar-denominated.

rationale: Raw source does not support the premise that these debt principal amounts are non-USD. The SOI header places Outstanding Principal, Amortized Cost, and Fair Value in money columns; representative rows show dollar symbols at the start of each run, while following rows omit the repeated symbol but remain in the same columns. A warehouse row from the flagged slice also shows dollar-denominated cost and fair value. Because the source shows USD presentation rather than non-USD principal requiring FX conversion, the FX01 firing is a false alarm caused by currency-symbol carry-forward/extraction, not a data error in principal_amount_usd.
